rows.remains: The node half exists, but the centre half does not: grep for compiled_plan in non-test sources outside qip-cli, qip-edge and libs finds only qip-edge-node. No composition root (qip-api, qip-fastbrain, qip-deepbrain, qip-kernel) produces the compiled_plan slot or the plan file; only qip-cli event_fabric/grant.rs fixtures do. A predicate-to-StrategySpec compiler would have no production caller. Also no node is deployed (execution_nodes empty or disabled in every committed tfvars) and delivery of the plan file to a node is deployment work. The Cond/Op/Value to Expr/Type/feature mapping and bounds contract still needs an ADR, a Proposed 0748 could be written but would not close the row.

The only caller of the competing-model simulation named in the register is qip-cli, which is not deployed; the deep brain's AmbientAgency is shadow plus internal outbox and was not shown to consult declared structural models. A qip-acceptance suite over the qip agency path would prove a path that no deployed binary takes.

Not attempted as code; no slice built. Findings for the next reader: (1) scope_inspections.rs FINANCIAL_AGI_CORE 'tool use' names qip-agents ToolRegistry, which is registry bookkeeping; the deployed tool invocation is the deep brain's ambient door, qip-agency DRAFT_TOOL ('outbox-draft') through the action guard, reached from qip-deepbrain main.rs AmbientAgency::open. The seam row should point there with a deepbrain test, and nothing else in the cycle invokes a registered tool. (2) Planning is the same shadow plus outbox path, by design under the paper boundary. (3) Closing needs a behavioural reachability proof per item across ten seams (kernel, deepbrain, qip-api desk, edge agents), each mutation-verified; scope_inspections is presence-only and a grep-for-symbol upgrade would not be proof. Too large to carry to COMPLETE in this lane without leaving a slice.
